# Visitor view access time display (2026-01-21 17:29Z)

_**User**_

it seems that in the visitor view the information about when the access has happened it always says "just now" - we need to debug and change this to the correct time + "nn seconds/minutes/hours ago"

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Custom)**_

        "contents": "    private func subtitleText(from cached: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let cached = cached else {\n            let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n            let never = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_never\", comment: \"Default value for never seen device\")\n            let separator = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_separator\", comment: \"Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle\")\n            let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_distance\", comment: \"Label for the distance to the device in the device list row\")\n            let unknown = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_unknown\", comment: \"Default value for unknown distance\")\n            return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(never) \\(separator) \\(distanceLabel): \\(unknown)\"\n        }\n        // Relative time\n        let now = Date()\n        let relativeTime = relativeTimeString(from: cached.timestamp, to: now, unitsStyle: .abbreviated)\n        // Add timezone offset if available\n        let timezoneOffset = timezoneOffsetString(deviceTimeZone: cache.getTimeZone(for: device.DeviceID))\n        let relativeTimeWithOffset = timezoneOffset != nil ? \"\\(relativeTime) (\\(timezoneOffset!))\" : relativeTime\n        // Distance calculation\n        guard let myCached = cache.getLocation(for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID) else {\n            let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n            return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(relativeTimeWithOffset)\"\n        }\n        let deviceLoc = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        let myLoc = CLLocation(latitude: myCached.latitude, longitude: myCached.longitude)\n        let distance = deviceLoc.distance(from: myLoc) // in meters\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Unique identifier combining DeviceID and TimeStamp for use in ForEach\n    public var uniqueID: String {\n        return \"\\(DeviceID)-\\(TimeStamp)\"\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "    func testVisitorHistorySorting() async throws {\n        let now = Date()\n        let visitors = [\n            MiataruVisitor(\n                DeviceID: \"DEVICE_1\",\n                TimeStamp: String(Int64(now.addingTimeInterval(-300).timeIntervalSince1970))\n            ),\n            MiataruVisitor(\n                DeviceID: \"DEVICE_2\",\n                TimeStamp: String(Int64(now.addingTimeInterval(-60).timeIntervalSince1970))\n            ),\n            MiataruVisitor(\n                DeviceID: \"DEVICE_3\",\n                TimeStamp: String(Int64(now.addingTimeInterval(-120).timeIntervalSince1970))\n            )\n        ]\n        \n        // Sort by most recent first\n        let sorted = visitors.sorted { $0.TimeStampDate &gt; $1.TimeStampDate }\n        \n        // Most recent should be first\n        #expect(sorted.first?.DeviceID == \"DEVICE_2\")\n        #expect(sorted.last?.DeviceID == \"DEVICE_1\")\n    }\n    \n    @Test(\"Shortened device ID format\")\n    func testShortenedDeviceID() async throws {\n        let longDeviceID = \"1234567890ABCDEF\"\n        let shortened = shortenedDeviceID(longDeviceID)\n        \n        // Should be first 6 + ... + last 4\n        #expect(shortened.hasPrefix(\"123456\"))\n        #expect(shortened.hasSuffix(\"CDEF\"))\n        #expect(shortened.contains(\"...\"))\n    }\n    \n    // Helper function matching the implementation\n    private func shortenedDeviceID(_ deviceID: String) -&gt; String {\n        guard deviceID.count &gt; 10 else { return deviceID }\n        let start = String(deviceID.prefix(6))\n        let end = String(deviceID.suffix(4))\n        return \"\\(start)...\\(end)\"\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    ///   - deviceID: The ID of the device to fetch the visitor history for.\n    ///   - amount: The maximum number of visitor history entries to retrieve.\n    /// - Returns: An array of visitor data objects.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func getVisitorHistory(serverURL: URL,\n                                  forDeviceID deviceID: String,\n                                  amount: Int) async throws -&gt; [MiataruVisitor] {\n        \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/GetVisitorHistory\")\n\n        let requestBody = GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody(\n            MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload(Device: deviceID, Amount: String(amount))\n        )\n\n        let data: Data\n        do {\n            data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, encodablePayload: requestBody) {\n                \"[MiataruAPIClient] Requesting visitor history for device \\(deviceID) amount=\\(amount) payload=\\($0)\"\n            }\n        } catch APIError.encodingError(let err) {\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Encoding visitor history request failed for device \\(deviceID): \\(err.localizedDescription)\")\n            throw APIError.encodingError(err)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse.self, from: data)\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Received visitor history entries=\\(response.MiataruVisitors.count) for device \\(deviceID)\")\n            return response.MiataruVisitors\n        } catch {\n            if let jsonString = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) {\n                debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Visitor history decode failed for device \\(deviceID). Payload=\\(jsonString)\")\n            }\n            throw APIError.decodingError(error)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Updates the location for a single device.\n    ///\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - serverURL: The base URL of the Miataru server.\n    ///   - locationData: The location data to be sent to the server.\n    ///   - enableHistory: Whether the server should store location history for this device.",

        "contents": "    private func updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: String) {\n        // Find the newest visitor entry for the target device\n        let targetVisits = cachedVisitorHistory.filter { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() == targetDeviceId.uppercased() }\n        guard let newestVisit = targetVisits.max(by: { $0.TimeStampDate &lt; $1.TimeStampDate }) else {\n            // No visits from target device, not mutual\n            isMutualNavigation = false\n            return\n        }\n        \n        let age = Date().timeIntervalSince(newestVisit.TimeStampDate)\n        \n        // Hysteresis: different thresholds for enter/exit\n        if isMutualNavigation {\n            // Currently mutual: exit if age &gt;= T_exit\n            isMutualNavigation = age &lt;= tExit\n        } else {\n            // Not currently mutual: enter if age &lt;= T_enter\n            isMutualNavigation = age &lt;= tEnter\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "        return first...last\n    }\n\n    func visibleHistory(in range: ClosedRange&lt;Double&gt;?) -&gt; [MiataruLocationData] {\n        guard let range else { return history }\n        if let cachedRange, cachedRange == range {\n            return cachedVisible\n        }\n\n        guard let startIndex = lowerBound(for: range.lowerBound),\n              let endIndex = upperBound(for: range.upperBound) else {\n            cachedRange = range\n            cachedVisible = []\n            return []\n        }\n\n        // If the requested range is inverted or empty, return an empty result\n        // to avoid constructing an invalid slice.\n        if startIndex &gt; endIndex {\n            cachedRange = range\n            cachedVisible = []\n            return []\n        }\n\n        let slice = Array(history[startIndex...endIndex])\n        cachedRange = range\n        cachedVisible = slice\n        return slice\n    }\n\n    func closest(to timestamp: Double, in range: ClosedRange&lt;Double&gt;?) -&gt; MiataruLocationData? {\n        guard !history.isEmpty else { return nil }\n        let searchTimestamps: [Double]\n        let searchEntries: [MiataruLocationData]\n\n        if let range {\n            let visible = visibleHistory(in: range)\n            guard !visible.isEmpty else { return nil }\n            searchEntries = visible\n            searchTimestamps = visible.map { $0.TimestampDate.timeIntervalSince1970 }\n        } else {\n            searchEntries = history\n            searchTimestamps = timestamps\n        }\n\n        guard let index = nearestIndex(to: timestamp, in: searchTimestamps) else { return nil }\n        return searchEntries[index]\n    }\n\n    /// Downsample entries for annotation display only (not for polyline).\n    /// Returns a subset of entries while maintaining chronological order.\n    func downsample(_ entries: [MiataruLocationData], selected: MiataruLocationData?, limit: Int = 150) -&gt; [MiataruLocationData] {\n        guard !entries.isEmpty else { return [] }",

Analyzing the logs: the timestamps are in milliseconds, but `TimeStampDate` treats them as seconds, causing incorrect dates.

Evidence:
- Line 1: `timeStamp`: `"1769016505149"` (milliseconds)
- Line 1: `currentTime`: `1769016891.6579552` (seconds)
- Line 2: `date`: `1769016505149` (treated as seconds, but it's milliseconds)
- Line 2: `diff`: `-1767247488257.3372` (negative because the date is far in the future)

Fix: divide the timestamp by 1000 before creating the Date. Updating `TimeStampDate` accordingly:

Applied fixes:

1. Root cause: `TimeStampDate` treated timestamps as seconds, but they're in milliseconds. Updated to divide by 1000.
2. Timer: Changed from 60 seconds to 1 second for accurate seconds display.
3. Formatting: Shows "nn sec ago" instead of "just now" for times < 60 seconds.
4. Localization: Added `time_ago_seconds` for all supported languages.

<reproduction_steps>

4. Wait a few seconds and observe that the seconds count updates in real-time
5. Scroll through the list to see different time ranges displayed correctly
</reproduction_steps>

        "contents": "        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n        let formattedDistance: String\n        if usesMetric {\n            let meterUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_meter_unit\", comment: \"Unit for meters in device row distance display\")\n            let kilometerUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_kilometer_unit\", comment: \"Unit for kilometers in device row distance display\")\n            if distance &lt; 1000 {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distance, meterUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%d %@\", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)\n            }\n        } else {\n            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_feet_unit\", comment: \"Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_miles_unit\", comment: \"Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048\n            let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34\n            if distanceInFeet &gt; 528 { // More than 1/10 mile\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.2f %@\", distanceInMiles, milesUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distanceInFeet, feetUnit)\n            }\n        }\n        let separator = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_separator\", comment: \"Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle\")\n        let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_last_seen\", comment: \"Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row\")\n        let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_distance\", comment: \"Label for the distance to the device in the device list row\")\n        return \"\\(lastSeen): \\(relativeTimeWithOffset) \\(separator) \\(distanceLabel): \\(formattedDistance)\"\n    }\n\n    private func placemarkText(from cached: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt; String {\n        ",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",

The app prioritizes user privacy, battery efficiency, and cross-platform compatibility.\\n\\n## 🏗️ Architecture Overview\\n\\n### Technology Stack\\n- **Frontend**: SwiftUI (iOS 18.0+)\\n- **State Management**: ObservableObject pattern with @Published properties\\n- **Data Persistence**: UserDefaults via SettingsManager; Application Support files for devices/groups\\n- **Location Services**: CoreLocation framework (foreground and significant-change background)\\n- **QR Code**: CodeScanner (scan), QRCode (generate)\\n- **Platforms**: iPhone and iPad\\n\\n### Core Components\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nmiataruApp.swift (Entry Point)\\n├── MiataruRootView (Main Navigation)\\n├── OnboardingContainerView (User Setup)\\n├── LocationManagers/\\n│   └── LocationMana [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                }

                {
                  "lineNumber": 13689,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"I’m considering using .onReceive with a custom publisher computed from settings.mapUpdateInterval to handle my updates, and also .onChange to resubscribe when there’s an interval change. Alternatively, I could just update the row’s subtitle based on a timer every second while keeping a reference to the latest cache location. I think it's better to implement this in iPhone_DeviceRowView by adding @ObservedObject for settings, a @State for displayedLocation, and a cancellable reference.\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13697,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"I'll add a throttled subscription in &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&amp;#96; to update displayed device locations only at &amp;#96;mapUpdateInterval&amp;#96;, refactor subtitle/place rendering to use that snapshot, and adjust geocoding triggers accordingly.\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13701,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"I think there's a better approach for the &amp;#96;iPhone_DevicesView&amp;#96;. Instead of binding directly to &amp;#96;cache.getLocation&amp;#96; in the row view, I can snapshot the location values using a timer set to &amp;#96;mapUpdateInterval&amp;#96;, then pass those to the row views. This keeps it decoupled from cache updates. We previously tried this with &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&amp;#96; by adding &amp;#96;displayedCachedLocation&amp;#96; and a Combine subscription to &amp;#96;cache.$locations&amp;#96;, but the patch failed because of a file mismatch. I should re-open &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&amp;#96; to check the current content and then plan my changes.&amp;lt;/details&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/think&amp;gt;\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13717,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  - Throttle im &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&amp;#96;: Ein Combine-Subscriber lauscht auf &amp;#96;cache.$locations&amp;#96;, sammelt nur Änderungen für das spezifische &amp;#96;device.DeviceID&amp;#96;, dedupliziert und throttelt mit &amp;#96;settings.mapUpdateInterval&amp;#96;. Anzeige nutzt &amp;#96;displayedCachedLocation&amp;#96;.\""
                }

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    /// The timestamp from the API is in milliseconds, so we divide by 1000.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            // Timestamps from the API are in milliseconds, convert to seconds\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts / 1000.0)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Unique identifier combining DeviceID and TimeStamp for use in ForEach\n    public var uniqueID: String {\n        return \"\\(DeviceID)-\\(TimeStamp)\"\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n            } else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    showHistoryView = true\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n\n    private func processNextGeocode() {\n        guard !isProcessingGeocode else { return }\n        guard !geocodeQueue.isEmpty else { return }\n        isProcessingGeocode = true\n        let nextDeviceID = geocodeQueue.removeFirst()\n        guard let cached = getLocation(for: nextDeviceID) else {\n            isProcessingGeocode = false\n            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in\n                self?.processNextGeocode()\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        let location = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in\n            guard let self = self else { return }\n            let pm = placemarks?.first\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\n                if let pm = pm {\n                    let country = pm.country\n                    let locality = pm.locality ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\n                    self.setPlacemark(for: nextDeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\n                }\n                self.isProcessingGeocode = false\n                // Be polite with geocoder\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {\n                    self.processNextGeocode()\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} ",

        "contents": "    private func formatAltitude(_ altitudeInMeters: Double) -&gt; (String, String) {\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n        \n        if usesMetric {\n            let altitudeValue = String(format: \"%.0f\", altitudeInMeters)\n            let altitudeUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"altitude_meters\", comment: \"Altitude in meters\")\n            return (altitudeValue, altitudeUnit)\n        } else {\n            // Convert meters to feet (1 meter = 3.28084 feet)\n            let altitudeInFeet = altitudeInMeters * 3.28084\n            let altitudeValue = String(format: \"%.0f\", altitudeInFeet)\n            let altitudeUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"altitude_feet\", comment: \"Altitude in feet\")\n            return (altitudeValue, altitudeUnit)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func startGeocodingIfNeeded() {\n        guard !isGeocoding else { return }\n        guard cache.getPlacemark(for: device.DeviceID) == nil else { return }\n        guard let cached = displayedCachedLocation ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\n                    cache.setPlacemark(for: device.DeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func areLocationsEqual(_ lhs: CachedDeviceLocation?, _ rhs: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt; Bool {\n        switch (lhs, rhs) {\n        case (nil, nil):\n            return true\n        ",

        "contents": "    private var bestAvailableLocation: CLLocationCoordinate2D {\n        // First priority: Device location (if available)\n        if let deviceLoc = deviceLocation {\n            return deviceLoc\n        }\n        \n        // Second priority: Cached device location\n        if let cached = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        }\n        \n        // Third priority: User's own location (if available and authorized)\n        if locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedWhenInUse || \n           locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedAlways,\n           let userLocation = locationManager.currentLocation {\n            return userLocation.coordinate\n        }\n        \n        // Fallback: Use fallback location (never returns nil)\n        return fallbackLocation\n    }\n    \n    // Computed property to get a sensible default location when no location is available\n    private var fallbackLocation: CLLocationCoordinate2D {\n        // Use user's location if available, otherwise use a central European location\n        if let userLocation = locationManager.currentLocation {\n            return userLocation.coordinate\n        }\n        \n        // Fallback to central Europe (Germany) instead of San Francisco\n        return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: 51.1657, longitude: 10.4515)\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {\n            // Map and error overlay",

String ?? \"\"\n        self.latitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"latitude\")\n        self.longitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"longitude\")\n        self.accuracy = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \"accuracy\")\n        self.timestamp = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"timestamp\") as? Date ?? Date()\n        self.country = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"country\") as? String\n        self.locality = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"locality\") as? String {\n            self.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: timeZoneIdentifier)\n        } else {\n            self.timeZone = nil\n        }\n        self.batteryLevel = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \"batteryLevel\") as? Double\n    }\n    \n    func encode(with aCoder: NSCoder) {\n        aCoder.encode(deviceID, forKey: \"deviceID\")\n        aCoder.encode(latitude, forKey: \"latitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(longitude, forKey: \"longitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(accuracy, forKey: \"accuracy\")\n        aCoder.encode(timestamp, forKey: \"timestamp\")\n        aCoder.encode(country, forKey: \"country\")\n        aCoder.encode(locality, forKey: \"locality\")\n        aCoder.encode(timeZone?.identifier, forKey: \"timeZoneIdentifier\")\n        aCoder.encode(batteryLevel, forKey: \"batteryLevel\")\n        aCoder.encode(altitude, forKey: \"altitude\")\n        aCoder.encode(speed, forKey: \"speed\")\n    }\n    \n    static var supportsSecureCoding: Bool {\n        return true\n    }\n}\n\nclass DeviceLocationCacheStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationCacheStore()\n    ",

        "contents": "        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n            } else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    showHistoryView = true\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

---


Updated the visitor history view to match the device list format. Changes:

1. **Device indicator**: Shows device color circle (or battery symbol if available), same as DeviceRowView
2. **Time display**: Uses "Last seen: [relative time] ([timezone offset])" format, matching DeviceRowView
3. **Location display**: Shows placemark (locality, country) and altitude if available from cache, same as DeviceRowView
4. **Real-time updates**: Uses `TimelineView` for per-second time updates
5. **Styling**: Matches DeviceRowView colors and spacing

The view now:
- Shows device name (or "Unknown device" with shortened ID)
- Displays "Last seen: 5 sec ago (+2)" format with timezone offset
- Shows location like "Berlin, Germany (Altitude: 50 m)" when available
- Uses the same visual style as the device list

Location data comes from `DeviceLocationCacheStore` for the visitor's device ID. If the device is in the cache, location and timezone are shown; otherwise, only the time is shown.

Build and test to verify the new format. The display should match the device list style.

if refresh should proceed, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        // Check application state on main thread\n        let isActive = await MainActor.run {\n            UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        }\n        \n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n        \n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt;     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./APP_FEATURES.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 24
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 46
          }
        },
        "contents": "- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; publishes the current location, permission state, server update status, altitude, speed, battery level (when available), and a log of recent updates. It switches between high‑accuracy updates in the foreground and significant‑change monitoring in the background, requests authorization when needed, and uploads data using &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;.\n- Low Power Mode and scene phase changes are observed (e.g., &#96;Notification.Name.NSProcessInfoPowerStateDidChange&#96;) to gate animations like shimmer/pulsing without changing data behavior.\n- &#96;iPhone_LocationStatusView&#96; renders &#96;LocationManager&#96; diagnostics, while &#96;SettingsManager&#96; bindings immediately adjust &#96;CLLocationManager&#96; configuration.\n\n## Device Management\n**For users:**\n- Maintain a list of devices, each with a name, ID, and optional color.\n- Add devices by scanning a Miataru QR code or entering the ID manually.\n- Swipe a row to delete, edit, or start navigation, pull down to refresh locations, and the last opened device is reopened automatically on launch.\n\n- Device rows show last update time, distance, and—when available—battery level and altitude. Units adapt to your locale (metric/imperial).\n- Pull‑to‑refresh also triggers reverse geocoding for visible devices to keep place names fresh.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; persists devices in &#96;Application Support&#96; and ensures the current device is always present.\n- &#96;iPhone_DevicesView&#96; uses a &#96;NavigationStack&#96; with &#96;refreshable&#96; and notification hooks to update cached locations and remember the last opened device.\n- &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; integrates &#96;CodeScanner&#96; to scan &#96;miataru://&#96; QR codes, offers a color picker, and prevents duplicate IDs.\n- &#96;DeviceRowView&#96; (shared) replaces &#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&#96;, displays battery/altitude/speed when available, and uses &#96;MeasurementFormatter&#96; with the system &#96;measurementSystem&#96; for localized units.\n- &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96; and static parts of markers are rasterized and cached to improve scrolling/rendering performance.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.",

## Changes Made:

### 1. **Server Limit Handling**
- Added `getVisitorHistoryWithConfig()` that returns the full response (config + visitors)
- When `amount` is `nil`, it:
  - First requests with a default (1000) to get server config
  - If more entries are available, requests again with the full available count
  - Uses `AvailableVisitorHistory` from the server config
- The view now requests all available visitor history instead of hardcoding 100

### 2. **Pull-to-Refresh**
- Replaced `.onAppear { loadVisitorHistory() }` with `.refreshable { await loadVisitorHistory() }`
- Kept `.onAppear` but only loads if visitors are empty (for initial load)
- Updated `loadVisitorHistory()` to be `async` to work with `.refreshable`
- Updated the sheet dismiss handler to use the async version

The visitor history view now:
- Uses pull-to-refresh like the devices list
- Requests all available visitor history from the server (respects server limits)
- Shows all available data instead of being limited to 100 entries

The implementation follows the same pattern as the devices list, using iOS's native pull-to-refresh gesture.

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    /// The timestamp from the API is in milliseconds, so we divide by 1000.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            // Timestamps from the API are in milliseconds, convert to seconds\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts / 1000.0)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Unique identifier combining DeviceID and TimeStamp for use in ForEach\n    public var uniqueID: String {\n        return \"\\(DeviceID)-\\(TimeStamp)\"\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "public struct GetLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public init(Device: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the GetLocationHistory request.\npublic struct GetLocationHistoryPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public let Amount: String\n    public init(Device: String, Amount: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Amount = Amount\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the GetVisitorHistory request.\npublic struct GetVisitorHistoryPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public let Amount: String\n    public init(Device: String, Amount: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Amount = Amount\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the UpdateLocation request.\npublic struct UpdateLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public var Timestamp: String\n    public var Longitude: Double\n    public var Latitude: Double\n    public var HorizontalAccuracy: Double\n    public var Speed: Double?\n    public var BatteryLevel: Double?\n    /// Altitude above mean sea level in meters\n    public var Altitude: Double?\n\n    /// Computed property für den Zugriff als Date\n    public var TimestampDate: Date {\n        get {\n            if let ms = Double(Timestamp) {\n                return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ms)\n            } else {\n                return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n            }\n        }\n        set {\n            Timestamp = String(Int64(newValue.timeIntervalSince1970))\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case Device, Timestamp, Longitude, Latitude, HorizontalAccuracy, Speed, BatteryLevel, Altitude\n    }\n\n    public init(Device: String, Timestamp: String, Longitude: Double, Latitude: Double, HorizontalAccuracy: Double, Speed: Double? = nil, BatteryLevel: Double? = nil, Altitude: Double? = nil) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Timestamp = Timestamp",

Updated the date format to use ordinal suffixes. The display now shows "10th May 2025" instead of "10. May 2025".

The format is:
- **Time**: `HH:mm:ss` (e.g., "14:30:45")
- **Date**: `dth MMMM yyyy` with ordinal suffixes (e.g., "10th May 2025", "1st January 2025", "22nd March 2025", "3rd December 2025")

Example: "Last seen: 5 sec ago (+2) (14:30:45 10th May 2025)"

The ordinal suffix helper adds:
- "st" for 1, 21, 31
- "nd" for 2, 22
- "rd" for 3, 23
- "th" for all other days (4-20, 24-30)

This matches standard English date formatting.

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",

        "contents": "# Cursor Rules for miataru iOS App\n\n## Project Context\nThis is an open-source iOS application for privacy-friendly location tracking, sharing, and device management. Built with SwiftUI and modern iOS frameworks (iOS 18 and iOS 26).\n\n## Code Style &amp; Standards\n- Use SwiftUI best practices\n- Follow iOS Human Interface Guidelines\n- Maintain privacy-first approach\n- Use English for all code comments and strings\n- Implement proper error handling and battery optimization\n\n## Architecture Guidelines\n- Use ObservableObject and @Published for state management\n- Keep views lightweight and delegate business logic to managers\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Use UserDefaults for settings persistence\n- Handle location permissions gracefully\n\n## Key Components\n- LocationManager: Handles location tracking and permissions\n- SettingsManager: Manages user preferences\n- Device management and QR code functionality\n- Multi-platform support (iPhone, iPad, Mac)\n\n## Development Workflow\n- Test on multiple device types\n- Consider battery optimization\n- Maintain privacy compliance\n- Follow iOS app store guidelines\n\n## Common Patterns\n- Use @StateObject for view models\n- Implement proper onboarding flow\n- Handle background/foreground transitions\n- Manage device identifiers securely\n\n## Localization Guidelines\n\n### String Localization\n**ALWAYS** use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; for all user-facing text strings with proper English descriptions.\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(NSLocalizedString(\"no_groups_available_create_new\", comment: \"No groups available. Create a new group to get started.\"))\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ❌ Incorrect Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(\"No groups available. Create a new group to get started.\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Localization Key Naming Convention\n- Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores\n- Follow the pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;\n- Examples:\n  - &#96;group_empty_add_devices_message&#96;\n  - &#96;no_groups_available_create_new&#96;\n  - &#96;edit_device&#96;\n  - &#96;delete_group&#96;\n\n### Comment Guidelines\n- Provide clear, descriptive English text in the comment parameter",

String {\n        let verticalAccuracy = location.verticalAccuracy",

        "contents": "class TestOutputContainer {\n\t// Note:  DateFormatter is thread safe\n\t// See https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/dateformatter#1680059\n\tstatic let iso8601Formatter: DateFormatter = {\n\t\tlet dateFormatter = DateFormatter()\n\t\tdateFormatter.locale = Locale(identifier: \"en_US_POSIX\") // set locale to reliable US_POSIX ISO8601\n\t\tdateFormatter.dateFormat = \"yyyy-MM-dd'T'HHmmssZ\"\n\t\treturn dateFormatter\n\t}()\n\n\tprivate lazy var __tmpFolder: URL = {\n\t\tlet u = FileManager.default\n\t\t\t.temporaryDirectory\n\t\t\t.appendingPathComponent(name)\n\t\t\t.appendingPathComponent(Self.iso8601Formatter.string(from: Date()))\n\t\ttry!         "contents": "    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationTextWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        AppIntentConfiguration(kind: \"DeviceLocationTextWidget\", intent: DeviceSelectionIntent.self, provider: DeviceLocationTextProvider()) { entry in\n            DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView(entry: entry)\n        }\n        .configurationDisplayName(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_display_name\", comment: \"Display name for the text location widget\"))\n        .description(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_text_description\", comment: \"Description for the text location widget\"))\n        .supportedFamilies([.systemSmall, .systemMedium, .accessoryRectangular])\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct BackgroundStatusCard: View {\n    @ObservedObject private var backgroundManager = LocationManager.shared\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {\n            HStack {\n                Image(systemName: \"clock.fill\")\n                    .foregroundColor(.purple)\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"background_status_header\", comment: \"Header for background location status card\"))\n                    .font(.headline)\n                Spacer()\n            }\n            \n            HStack {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"background_updates_label\", comment: \"Label for number of background updates\"))\n                Spacer()\n                Text(\"\\(backgroundManager.backgroundUpdateCount)\", comment: \"Number of background updates\")\n                    .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n            }\n            \n            if let lastUpdate = backgroundManager.lastBackgroundUpdate {\n                HStack {\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"last_background_update_label\", comment: \"Label for timestamp of the last background update\"))\n                    Spacer()\n                    Text(formatTime(lastUpdate))\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .padding()\n        .background(Color(.systemGray6))\n        .cornerRadius(12)\n    }\n    \n    private func formatTime(_ date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.dateStyle = .none\n        formatter.timeStyle = .medium\n        return formatter.string(from: date)\n    }\n}\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_LocationStatusView()\n} ",

        "contents": "public extension QRCode.Message {\n\t/// A formattter for a generating a basic event QRCode\n\t@objc(QRCodeMessageEvent) class Event: NSObject, QRCodeMessageFormatter {\n\t\t/// The encoded data\n\t\tpublic let data: Foundation.Data\n\t\t/// The content to be displayed in the qr code\n\t\tpublic let text: String?\n\n\t\t/// Create a message containing an event\n\t\t/// - Parameters:\n\t\t///   - summary: The event summary\n\t\t///   - location: The event's location\n\t\t///   - start: The start time\n\t\t///   - end: The end time\n\t\t@objc public init(summary: String, location: String, start: Date, end: Date) throws {\n\n\t\t\tlet summary = summary.removing(charactersIn: \"\\r\\n\")\n\t\t\tlet location = location.removing(charactersIn: \"\\r\\n\")\n\n\t\t\tvar msg = \"BEGIN:VEVENT\\r\\n\"\n\t\t\tmsg += \"SUMMARY:\\(summary)\\r\\n\"\n\t\t\tmsg += \"LOCATION:\\(location)\\r\\n\"\n\n\t\t\t// Convert dates to UTC\n\t\t\t//19980119T070000Z\n\n\n\t\t\tlet df = DateFormatter()\n\t\t\tdf.timeZone = TimeZone(abbreviation: \"UTC\")\n\t\t\tdf.dateFormat = _formatString\n\n\t\t\tlet dtstart = df.string(from: start)\n\t\t\tmsg += \"DTSTART:\\(dtstart)\\r\\n\"\n\t\t\tlet dtend = df.string(from: end)\n\t\t\tmsg += \"DTEND:\\(dtend)\\r\\n\"\n\n\t\t\tmsg += \"END:VEVENT\"\n\n\t\t\tself.text = msg\n\t\t\tguard let msgData = self.text?.data(using: .utf8) else {\n\t\t\t\tthrow QRCodeError.unableToConvertTextToRequestedEncoding\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tself.data = msgData\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}",

Updated the code to internationalize ordinal suffixes. Changes:

1. **Uses system locale**: The date formatter now uses `Locale.current` instead of hardcoded "en_US", so dates format according to the user's language.

2. **Conditional ordinal suffixes**: Ordinal suffixes (st, nd, rd, th) are only added for English locales. Other languages use their native date formats without ordinals.

3. **Time format**: Time remains `HH:mm:ss` across all locales.

Examples:
- **English**: "14:30:45 10th May 2025"
- **German**: "14:30:45 10. Mai 2025" (no ordinal)
- **French**: "14:30:45 10 mai 2025" (no ordinal)
- **Spanish**: "14:30:45 10 de mayo de 2025" (no ordinal)
- **Japanese**: Uses Japanese date formatting

The code checks if the current locale's language is English (`currentLocale.language.languageCode?.identifier == "en"`) before adding ordinal suffixes, so other languages display dates in their native format.
